reason: The checkout endpoint verifies the session cookie with authlib's JsonWebSignature.verify, which accepts a forged signature on Authlib 1.8.0; the same request is rejected on 1.9.0, and the proof test fails on the vulnerable version and passes on the fixed one.

path.note: POST /checkout verifies the session cookie with the vulnerable function

fix.detail: Pin authlib==1.9.0 in src/requirements.txt (the fix.diff computed by the orchestrator is the version-pin change)

follow_ups: A malformed session cookie crashes the checkout endpoint with a 500 instead of a clean 401.
